title: Oracle EBS Consultant
summary: Oracle EBS consultants build and support customisations in Oracle E-Business Suite, an older on-premises ERP (software that runs finance and supply chain), using PL/SQL, Forms, Reports and Workflow. They sit in an ERP or managed-services team and work with business users on support tickets and enhancements.
dailyDuties: Build reports, interfaces, conversions and extensions
Write and tune PL/SQL for data loads
Turn functional specs into technical designs
Build BI Publisher reports for business users
Test changes and move them through instances

skills.expectation: Build RICE components with Forms, Reports, Workflow and OAF in EBS R12
Know the Financials or SCM module flows you support
Write PL/SQL packages for interfaces and conversions
Write and tune SQL against EBS tables
Build BI or XML Publisher reports
Turn business needs into functional and technical designs
Fix L2 and L3 production tickets within SLA
Work directly with business users and onsite teams
Write Unix shell scripts for file loads
Build APEX pages on top of EBS
